# `mlangd-mla` manual

```roff
.TH MLANGD-MLA 1 "May 2026" "MLang" "User Commands"
.SH NAME
mlangd-mla \- self-hosted MLang Language Server Protocol scaffold
.SH SYNOPSIS
.B mlangd-mla
[\fB\-v\fR|\fB\-\-version\fR]
[\fB\-\-enable\-log\fR]
[\fB\-\-log\-level\fR \fILEVEL\fR]
[\fB\-\-log\-dir\fR \fIDIR\fR]
[\fB\-\-log\-color\fR|\fB\-\-log\-colors\fR]
.SH DESCRIPTION
.B mlangd-mla
is the self-hosted MLang implementation of the language server scaffold. It
speaks LSP over stdio and is primarily intended for bootstrap, parity work,
and experimentation alongside the native
.BR mlangd (1)
server.
.PP
When started without
.BR \-\-version ,
the process immediately enters its stdio JSON-RPC loop.
.SH OPTIONS
.TP
.BR \-v ", " \-\-version
Print the tool version and exit.
.TP
.B \-\-enable\-log
Enable internal file logging.
.TP
.B \-\-log\-level \fILEVEL\fR
Select the log level. Supported values are
.BR DEBUG ,
.BR INFO ,
.BR ERROR ,
.BR WARN ,
and
.BR VERBOSE .
.TP
.B \-\-log\-dir \fIDIR\fR
Write the log file below
.IR DIR .
The default log directory is
.IR /tmp ,
and the file name is
.IR mlangd-mla.log .
.TP
.BR \-\-log\-color ", " \-\-log\-colors
Enable colored log-level tags in the log file output.
.SH EXAMPLES
.nf
mlangd-mla --version
mlangd-mla --enable-log --log-level INFO --log-dir /tmp
mlangd-mla --enable-log --log-level VERBOSE --log-colors
.fi
.SH SEE ALSO
.BR mlangd (1),
.BR mlang-format (1),
.BR mlang (1)
```
